facts.fact: Urban households are 1.5 times more likely to use connected TV (CTV) than rural households, according to Marketing LTB research (October 2025).
facts.quote: Urban households are 1.5x more likely to use connected TV (CTV) than rural households, according to [Marketing LTB]

facts.fact: According to FCC research, 73% of adults in rural areas had home broadband access in 2023.
facts.quote: 73% of adults in rural areas had home broadband access in 2023, compared to 77% in urban areas and 86% in suburban areas.

facts.fact: According to Pew Research Center surveys, only 49% of rural Americans say there is a TV station covering their local area.
facts.quote: Only 49% of rural Americans say there is a TV station covering their local area, compared to 64% of suburban residents and 70% of urban dwellers.

facts.fact: According to Pew Research Center surveys, 34% of rural Americans report having no local TV station at all.
facts.quote: More than a third of rural Americans (34%) report having no local TV station at all.

facts.fact: According to the Innovative Systems 2024 Rural Broadband and Video Report, 60% of rural Americans receive their home internet service from the same company that provides their TV service.
facts.quote: 60% of rural Americans receive their home internet service from the same company that provides their TV service, often as a bundle.

facts.fact: The page lists 10% of urban viewers as having no local TV station.
facts.quote: No local TV station:** 10% urban, 17% suburban, 34% rural

facts.fact: The page states that there is a 1.5x CTV gap between urban and rural viewing, which it says means streaming-only strategies under-reach rural audiences.
facts.quote: The 1.5x CTV gap means streaming-only advertising strategies systematically under-reach rural audiences.

facts.fact: The page says many rural healthcare patients drive 30 or more miles for care.
facts.quote: Healthcare providers in regional markets serve patients who drive 30 or more miles for care

facts.fact: Adwave states that its streaming TV advertising campaigns start at $30 a day with no production costs.
facts.quote: With campaigns starting at just $30 a day and no production costs

facts.fact: The page recommends combining streaming ads for the 73% of rural households with broadband, though it does not cite a source for this figure.
facts.quote: Combine streaming ads (for the 73% with broadband)

facts.fact: The page says the 2021 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act allocated $65 billion for broadband expansion.
facts.quote: The 2021 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act allocated $65 billion for broadband expansion

facts.fact: Per the page's Q&A, 27% of rural Americans lack reliable high-speed internet entirely, which the page cites as the primary barrier to streaming adoption in rural areas.
facts.quote: Streaming requires consistent high-speed internet, which 27% of rural Americans lack entirely

facts.fact: The page states that 86% of suburban households have broadband access, higher than both urban and rural households.
facts.quote: With 86% broadband access (higher than both urban and rural)

facts.fact: The page reports that 64% of suburban residents have local TV stations, compared with 49% in rural communities.
facts.quote: 64% reporting local TV stations compared to 49% in rural communities

facts.fact: The page states that 69% of suburban households participate in local online forums, the highest rate among the community types it compares.
facts.quote: Suburban households also show the highest rates of local online forum participation at 69%

facts.fact: Per Marketing LTB (October 2025), urban households are 1.5 times more likely to use CTV than rural households.
facts.quote: Urban households 1.5x more likely to use CTV than rural

facts.fact: Per the FCC (2023), 73% of rural adults have home broadband, compared with 86% of suburban adults.
facts.quote: 73% of rural adults have home broadband vs 86% suburban

facts.fact: Per Pew Research (May 2024), 49% of rural Americans have a local TV station, compared with 70% of urban Americans.
facts.quote: 49% of rural Americans have a local TV station vs 70% urban

facts.quote: 34% of rural Americans say no TV station covers their area

facts.fact: Per Innovative Systems (2024), 60% of rural Americans get their internet service from their TV provider.
facts.quote: 60% of rural Americans get internet from their TV provider

facts.quote: 69% suburban have local online forums vs 59% rural, 55% urban
